svg.title: Resource windows: the size classes a node can hold
svg.desc: The four Pecos parking windows plus the TRAY window the parser adds, drawn to scale and nested; their area-sorted indices 0 to 4 and collision entity ids 4 to 8; the buffer that is added but never used; Pecos stall spacing against the XL and buffered windows; which nodes allow which size; height_m.

g.text: Absent: height_m stays 0, which every reader treats as "unconstrained" (GetSmallestEnclosingResourceSizeIndex, IsPayloadWithinBaySizeLimits, OpenSpaceSearchEnvironment::OnExpansion).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Present: it must be <= kBayHeight, or the parser throws "Parking window '<name>' has height_m=<h> which exceeds the physical bay clearance kBayHeight=<k>" (layout.cpp L102-108). kBayHeight's value is not in the snapshots.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: TRAY gets kTrayHeight. The buffer drops height (GetBufferedResourceWindowHelper sets only length and width). Pecos sets no height_m, so its four windows are height-unconstrained.

g.text: Windows, buffer, node coordinates and max_resource_size from 5675_pecos_combined.yaml; parsing, sorting and checks from layout.cpp L86-151; buffer from layout.cpp GetBufferedResourceWindowHelper; consumers from polygon_utils.cpp, pose_graph.cpp, collision_geometry.hpp/.cpp, the motion planner (SIPP,

g.text: parking_windows defines discrete payload sizes. The parser adds TRAY, sorts all five by area, insists that each fits inside the next, and numbers them 0 to 4; a node's max_resource_size admits sizes 0 up to its own. The buffer is added only in code that nothing calls.
